lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4 to 5 low-contrast, thin white vertical line segments observed on the mid-to-posterior torso, spaced at irregular intervals ranging from 30 to 50 pixels.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines on the central torso appear as fragmented dashes, failing to maintain continuity across the full vertical span of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Isolated single high-contrast white spot on the mid-posterior haunch; secondary lower-contrast spot near the ventral margin of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial upward/outward vector from the skull base, transitioning to a sharp inward-facing terminal curve toward the midline.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 terminal tip distance relative to the estimated width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tips represent approximately 0.12 to 0.15 of the total vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white chevron marking between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible; presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker on the dorsal line.
